name: manage_voice
description: Use one unified voice surface for official ChatCut voices and the current user's cloned voices. For voice selection, call action="list" with voiceType="all". It returns one normalized candidate list: custom voices first, followed by filtered official voices. Build one playable audition UI from these returned tuples; never merge a static Skill catalog with a separate custom-voice lookup. Official voices support only action="list" and return provider + voiceId for submit_voice. Custom voices support list, check-create-access, apply, clone, preview, rename, and delete; their customVoiceId is used with submit_voice provider="fish-audio" after apply succeeds. Keep provider names and provider-specific identifiers internal. Clone only after explicit ownership/permission confirmation, and delete only after explicit permanent-delete confirmation.

age.description: For official/all list: optional age bucket.

confirmedConsent.description: Custom clone only. True only after explicit ownership or permission confirmation.

confirmedDelete.description: Custom delete only. True only after explicit permanent-delete confirmation.

customVoiceId.description: Required for custom apply, preview, rename, and delete.

gender.description: For official/all list: optional requested gender.

language.description: For official/all list: target narration language, independent from locale.

limit.description: For official/all list: optional maximum official results. Omit it to return the complete matching official catalog. Custom voices are not counted against this limit.

locale.description: For official/all list: visible name and summary language.

name.description: Required for custom clone and rename.

previewText.description: Required for custom clone and preview.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

provider.description: For official/all list: optional internal provider filter. Usually omit.

query.description: For list: optional name, tone, use-case, tag, or custom voice search.

sourceAssetId.description: Required for custom clone. Must be a ChatCut audio asset id.

tags.description: For official/all list: optional exact tags.

voiceType.description: Use "all" for the normal combined audition list, "official" for the read-only curated catalog, or "custom" for cloned voices.
